    Yuanyuan Yuan (袁渊源)

    Assistant Professor (Tenure-Track)
    School of Software, Tsinghua University
    E-mail: yyyuan@tsinghua.edu.cn
    国家级青年人才

    My research focuses on the safety and security of AI systems, both in the digital and the physical worlds.

    Before joining Tsinghua University, I was a post-doc researcher at ETH Zurich (2024-2025), working with Prof. Zhendong Su. I obtained my Ph.D. degree from HKUST in 2024 under the supervision of Prof. Shuai Wang, and my B.S. degree from Fudan University in 2020.

    Openings: I am always looking for self-motivated students (Post-doc, PhD, Master, and Undergraduate). If you are interested in joining my group, please drop me an email with your CV and transcripts.
